card.name: Start of PREZISTA-type brand names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand name written in capitals, mostly the PRE in PREZISTA, PREZCOBIX and PREVDUO, after words like 'of' or 'and'. It also fires on a joining piece inside capitalized or branded terms.

modes.description: A hyphen or short piece inside a trademark or all-caps heading.
